title: Platform Onboarding & Mastery Milestones

implementation_scope.purpose: Define deterministic read-only platform onboarding and mastery milestone content over the frozen ALP-02 achievement definition/criteria/evidence contract.
authorized: ordered milestone stage and prerequisite-reference projection
explicit ALP-02 definition and criterion references
deterministic progress-state projection from authorized ALP-02 evidence
optional guidance metadata that explains next learning steps without granting capability
deterministic milestone receipts independent of input ordering
not_authorized: GM-authored campaign achievements, titles, reputation or reward links
universal permission or unrelated capability gates
provider activation, tester distribution, release or deployment
